about: rope_threading redesign: the route recipe per tier for the final round on the frozen head (main 10-12: references are recorded once, after the physics freeze). Per tier: build the instance (session_build), plan (plan_tier.py; relay_plan's LAY_WALL_CLEAR_M default 0.08 = plan8), run the closed-loop oracle (robot_relay) with the settings below, then fresh replays (robot_replay) on 2 hosts; forcing is read from the fresh replays only (the Session's live summary can lose events across the executor's rewinds). A run with 0 rewinds has its live forcing summary equal to a fresh replay's (deterministic); with rewinds, read a fresh replay.
